chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from al-Mu'alla ibn Muhammad from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha' from Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) who said:

I heard him saying regarding marriage: He said, 'Indeed, from the Sunnah is marriage at night because Allah, Exalted and Mighty, said: "He made the night for rest"; and women are indeed a rest (tranquility).'

key_terms.جَعَلَ اللَّيْلَ سَكَناً: He made the night for rest (Quranic reference)

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling regarding the timing of marriage ceremonies or consummation according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) establishes the Sunnah of night marriage or consummation by linking the Quranic description of night as a time of tranquility ('sakana') to the marital bond, where spouses serve as mutual sources of peace. This hadith, found in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, underscores the spiritual and emotional dimensions of intimacy, framing it not merely as physical union but as a means of achieving divine serenity within the family structure.
